subject: design/fleet-bridge-v1
statement: The pipeline map's stage-8 row and footer state the external-fleet binding as it operationally runs — frozen plans project onto the tracker with the repo-configured automated-implementation tag and an external fleet claims and implements them — and the map remains the live, PR-corrected surface owning that value (its own header already binds it descriptive and corrected-to-match). This design deliberately freezes no copy of the row's wording: the binding duty is FR-10's, the current value is the map's, and when the engine era changes the operational binding, the map moves and FR-10's fit re-pins by amendment (the basis's own hook). The correction lands with this design's implementation; its whole footprint is the map row and footer. What taught the deferral was the stale row itself, never a guidance directive — no guidance surface carries one today (the drive guide already directs the unconditional trigger) — so the durable duty is the standing negative one DINV-5 binds and A-4 inspects: no drive guidance may direct deferring materialization on the row's account, a duty that holds vacuously today.
